hosted.name: PcapAI
hosted.pitch: Upload a capture, get a free summary in about two minutes and a client-ready PDF for $9. No account. Sample report online.
hosted.epitaph: Alive, and charging nine dollars. That is more business model than most of this cemetery ever had.

hosted.name: logcat.ai PCAP Analyzer
hosted.pitch: AI analysis of .pcap and .pcapng with 802.11 issues, retransmissions, scans and beaconing, each finding cited to a frame.
hosted.epitaph: A log analysis company that noticed packets are also logs, if you squint.

hosted.name: NetNerve
hosted.pitch: Turns .pcap analysis 'from hours into seconds' with LLaMA 3 on Groq. Made headlines a day after launch, according to its author.
hosted.epitaph: Outgrew its vercel.app address and moved to a real domain. In this neighbourhood that counts as a dynasty.
hosted.last_sign_note: netnerve.vercel.app redirects to netnerve.online, site up

hosted.name: PcapAnalyzer
hosted.pitch: 27 detectors with a severity and a next step, runs locally in Docker, optional AI with your own key. Apache 2.0, beta.
hosted.epitaph: The newborn. Honest about being a beta, honest about only seeing sample captures. We will be back in six months with flowers or a cake.

hosted.name: PacketSafari
hosted.pitch: AI-assisted packet investigation with exact packet evidence: ranks the important signals, shows the flows and frames, and lets you verify every conclusion. In daily development.
hosted.epitaph: Alive, and the one keeping this register. No stone, only a spade. Judged by the same dates as everyone else.

hosted.name: Selector Packet Copilot
hosted.pitch: Upload a capture of about 5 MB, it is converted to JSON and indexed into Gemini File Search for chat. Heir to Packet Buddy.
hosted.epitaph: Answered our visit with HTTP 503 and the words 'unconditional drop overload'. Network people will appreciate the root cause being in the banner.
hosted.last_sign_note: HTTP 503 on the day we checked

hosted.name: A-Packets
hosted.pitch: Online PCAP analyzer from before the gold rush, now with AI-assisted reports. Free tier reports are public.
hosted.epitaph: Was here before the AI tools arrived and will be here after. Listed as the cemetery's groundskeeper.

hosted.name: PacketSnitch
hosted.pitch: Desktop PCAP analyzer; a language model reads the structured output the analyzer already produced, not the raw capture. Can run fully local.
hosted.epitaph: The page says 'Last updated: November 21, 2026'. A site that states its own date of last activity. We could retire.

hosted.name: PCAP Analyser (cloudssfdc)
hosted.pitch: Upload .pcap, .pcapng or .har and get a plain-English report with root cause and fix in under 60 seconds.
hosted.epitaph: Four followers and one review on Product Hunt, three stars. Root cause in sixty seconds, audience still pending.

hosted.name: AuraSniff
hosted.pitch: Terminal PCAP analyzer powered by Gemini and Claude. Six followers on Product Hunt.
hosted.epitaph: aurasniff.com is a shop for perfume and body spray. We assume it is unrelated. It is still the best-smelling entry here.

hosted.name: VisualEther
hosted.pitch: Sequence diagrams from Wireshark captures since long before LLMs; now ships an MCP server so Claude Code can explain failures.
hosted.epitaph: An elder that learned MCP. Not vibe-coded, just adapting to the climate.

hosted.name: Cisco Meraki AI PCAP Analyzer
hosted.pitch: Turns Meraki wireless captures into plain-language diagnostics inside the Dashboard. Needs the right licence.
hosted.epitaph: Will not die. Will be renamed.

hosted.name: GNS3 AI packet analysis
hosted.pitch: AI packet analysis inside the GNS3 3.1 lab tool.
hosted.epitaph: Every product gets an AI tab eventually. This is the lab simulator's.

hosted.name: PacketPilot AI
hosted.pitch: Not an analyzer: a guide, a prompt pack for network admins and a weekly pcap puzzle.
hosted.epitaph: Skipped building the tool and sells the prompts. Possibly the only one here that read the room.

hosted.name: Fraunhofer NetCapVis
hosted.pitch: Research visualisation for captures, drag a file in. Now has an AI analysis page.
hosted.epitaph: Publicly funded, therefore immortal.

hosted.name: ChatTCP
hosted.pitch: Read TCP and UDP packets like a chat log, with commentary on every packet, automatic retransmission and handshake checks, and an AI assistant. Online or as a download.
hosted.epitaph: Turns a three-way handshake into a group chat. SYN left on read.

hosted.name: LLM-Shark
hosted.pitch: Windows Store app for 4G, 5G and IMS signalling: ask in natural language, get diagnostics and sequence diagrams. Three captures a day free, bring your own LLM API.
hosted.epitaph: Announced in one forum post, which is also the whole thread. The signalling was one-way.

hosted.name: PCAP-LM
hosted.pitch: A method for rewriting a capture so an assistant can read it in one pass, after noticing that a few megabytes of traffic become nearly 20 million tokens as text.
hosted.epitaph: Research, so it cannot die. It can only stop being cited.

hosted.name: cPacket AI
hosted.pitch: AI-driven insights on top of a packet capture and observability platform: baselines, anomaly detection, MCP support for your own models. Sold as an uplift on capture pricing.
hosted.epitaph: Has hardware, customers and a price list. Wandered in by mistake and is asking the way out.

hosted.name: Riverbed IQ (NPM 360)
hosted.pitch: Agentic AI wired into AppResponse and NetProfiler: correlates the evidence, recommends next steps, lets you drill down to the packets. Launched September 2026.
hosted.epitaph: Causal, predictive, generative and agentic, all in one press release. Too large for a plot; has been offered the mausoleum.

hosted.name: DynamiteLab (formerly PacketTotal)
hosted.pitch: PacketTotal launched in 2017 and became DynamiteLab in 2023: a public PCAP analysis platform used by a large community for almost a decade.
hosted.epitaph: 2017 – June 6, 2026. The only resident with a proper obituary on its own front page. Not vibe-coded, not a weekend project, and still gone. Rest well.
hosted.last_sign_note: shut down, says its own front page

hosted.name: Red Hand Analytics
hosted.pitch: Free online PCAP analyzer: upload .pcap, .pcapng or .etl and get a connected investigation of activities, endpoints, DNS and data movement. 100 MB without an account.
hosted.epitaph: Caught red-handed being useful. Under observation.

hosted.name: pcapanalyzer.com
hosted.pitch: 'Advanced PCAP Analyzer for Network Professionals', 'the ultimate PCAP analysis tool', with AI-powered PCAP analysis.
hosted.epitaph: Says 'PCAP' and 'analysis' more often per paragraph than any capture contains SYNs. The search engines have been notified.

epitaphs.automateyournetwork/packet_buddy: The ancestor. Showed in early 2024 that you can talk to a capture, and several hundred repositories took that personally.
epitaphs.0xKoda/WireMCP: Most starred headstone in the yard. Six hundred people bookmarked it for later.
epitaphs.kspviswa/local-packet-whisperer: 'A fun project', says the description. Honest advertising deserves a proper stone.
epitaphs.a77lic7ion/IntelliPCAP.AI: The demo greets every visitor with 'Your enterprise plan allows files up to 2GB. Credits: Unlimited.' One star. Generous to the end.
epitaphs.elkentaro/sharkbot: One hundred stars in two days of commits. Efficient.
epitaphs.krantikumara/-kranti-sip-pcap-analyzer: Created and last pushed on the same day, 133 stars. The leading dash in the name is original.
epitaphs.tuliperis/SharkMCP: One of at least two SharkMCPs. This one lived for a day.
epitaphs.weirdmachine64/SharkMCP: The other SharkMCP. Lived a day longer than its namesake.
epitaphs.bx33661/Wireshark-MCP: 'Production-grade', says PyPI. Still pushing, so no flowers yet.
epitaphs.netwho/PacketCircle: A Wireshark plugin that draws traffic as a circle. No AI in the description, which makes it the most honest entry in the yard.
epitaphs.kiskander/pt-mcp-server: Not packets, Packet Tracer: an MCP server that builds CCNA labs for you and refuses to reveal the graded answers. Admitted on the undertaker's personal invitation.
epitaphs.ProxymanApp/TCPViewer: A native Mac app by people who ship native Mac apps for a living. Six hundred stars and a pulse. Came to visit, brought flowers.
epitaphs.lyatanski/webshark: Wireshark in a browser, in Kubernetes and on a phone, announced with 'I would appreciate feedback'. Twelve upvotes. We appreciate it too.
epitaphs.roxlukas/ai_pcap_explain: 'Explain pcap using local LLM model.' One day, one star, no further explanation.
epitaphs.mostlygino/Kagami: Kagami means mirror. A native macOS viewer on Wireshark's own dissectors, so at least the decoding is not a hallucination.
